summary: Load carried from a shipment's pickup to its delivery; consumes capacity between the two steps.
range: Array of non-negative integers; dimension count must match vehicles.capacity.
businessRules: Load added at pickup, removed at delivery; capacity honored cumulatively while onboard (C1+C4).

amount defines: This parameter defines the quantity that needs to be shipped. This attribute supports multidimensional quantities, to support shipment of quantities of different units/dimensions. It is recommended…
Each element in amount must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.capacity, shipments.pickup, shipments.delivery. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: amount [3] on capacity [5] carried between the two steps.
Boundary: amount equal to capacity (amount [5] on capacity [5]) fits between the steps.
Multi-dimension: amount [2,3] on capacity [10,10] within both dimensions.
Negative-validation: amount dimension count != capacity dimension count -> 400.
Negative-infeasible: two shipments each amount [3] onboard together on capacity [5] -> one deferred (6>5).
Interaction: Negative: capacity [10,100] but a job delivery [5] (1 dim vs 2) -> HTTP 400 input validation failed.
Interaction: Positive: capacity [10,100] with all deliveries/pickups/amounts 2-dimensional -> accepted.
Interaction: Consistency: alternative_capacities with different dimension than primary capacity -> HTTP 400.
Interaction: Consistency: min_stop_load [20,30] but capacity [10,100] only -> dimension mismatch HTTP 400.
Interaction: Infeasible: delivery time window earlier than the pickup window -> precedence infeasible -> both unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: two amount [3] shipments onboard together on capacity [5] -> one deferred by capacity.
Interaction: Precedence: pickup [10:00,11:00], delivery [09:00,09:30] (delivery before pickup) -> both unassigned.
